items.title: The acyclicity lemma: the top cohomology of a bounded complex with depth constraints has depth at least one
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The acyclicity lemma states that for a complex of finite modules over a local Noetherian ring whose i-th term has depth at least i, the cohomology at the largest index where exactness fails has depth at least one (statement lines 25009-25023). The proof does not use spectral sequences or a resolution argument: it breaks the complex into a chain of short exact sequences exposing that cohomology group, then propagates depth bounds along the chain using the depth lemma, starting from the given bounds on the top terms (proof lines 25024-25048). The bookkeeping of which sequence yields which bound is the content, and the author writes every step out. H2.
